types.name: ActivityHeatmapProps
types.doc: A contribution style calendar: one square per day, weeks as columns, with four accent tints for how busy a day was. Use it when rhythm, streaks, and quiet weeks matter more than exact comparisons; use a bar chart when the exact comparison is the point. Cells wave in once on view, a tooltip glides between cells on hover or keyboard focus, and a new range recolors the grid in a sweep instead of redrawing it. Arrow keys move by day and week, Enter selects.

members.name: days
members.doc: One entry per day, oldest first. Days missing inside the range count as zero.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name for the grid, such as "Contributions in 2025".

members.name: period
members.doc: Finishes the summary line: "1,284 contributions in {period}".

members.name: thresholds
members.doc: Upper bounds for levels one to three; anything above the last is level four. Defaults to quarters of the busiest day.

members.name: actions
members.doc: Controls beside the summary, such as a range switch.

members.name: locale
members.doc: Formatting locale. Fixed by default so server and client render the same labels.
